item.text: Audiveris could not start because it requires Java 25; the installed runtime is Java 21. I’ll try a compatible runtime and retain the recognition logs. The parent’s checks accepted empty melody scores, so validation must also require actual recognized events.

{"tool":"run","argument":"PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp python - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,tarfile,subprocess,os
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
base=Path('/workspace'); tmp=base/'tmp'; raw=base/'recognition'; raw.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
url='https://api.azul.com/metadata/v1/zulu/packages/?java_version=25&os=linux&arch=aarch64&archive_type=tar.gz&java_package_type=jre&release_status=ga&availability_types=CA&latest=true'
packages=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=25)); package=next(p for p in packages if 'musl' not in p['name'] and 'fx' not in p['name'])
print('JAVA_PACKAGE',package['download_url'],flush=True)
archive=tmp/'java25.tar.gz'; urllib.request.urlretrieve(package['download_url'],archive)
root=tmp/'java25'; root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with tarfile.open(archive) as f:f.extractall(root,filter='data')
java=next(root.glob('*/bin/java')); print(subprocess.run([str(java),'-version'],capture_output=True,text=True).stderr,flush=True)
enlarged=base/'enlarged'; enlarged.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
images=[]
for src in sorted((base/'inputs').glob('sample-*.png')):
 im=Image.open(src).convert('RGB'); dest=enlarged/src.name; im.resize((im.width*4,im.height*4)).save(dest); images.append(str(dest))
app=tmp/'audiveris-root/opt/audiveris/lib/app'
cmd=[str(java),'-Xmx1200m','-Djava.awt.headless=true','--add-exports=java.desktop/sun.awt.image=ALL-UNNAMED','--enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED','-cp',str(app/'*'),'Audiveris','-batch','-export','-output',str(raw),'--']+images
(base/'recognition-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(cmd,indent=2))
env=os.environ.copy(); env['TMPDIR']=str(tmp)
with (base/'audiveris.log').open('w') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=env)
 try: code=p.wait(timeout=75)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: code='still_running'
print('PROCESS',p.pid,'STATUS',code)
print((base/'audiveris.log').read_text()[-12000:])
print('FILES',[str(p.relative_to(base)) for p in raw.rglob('*') if p.is_file()])
print('OCR_FILES',[str(p) for p in tmp.rglob('*') if p.name in ('tesseract','eng.traineddata')][:30])
PY","why":"Replace the incompatible Java 21 runtime with Java 25 and run fresh Audiveris recognition on all seven enlarged images, retaining its command, logs and raw exports for conversion and diagnosis."}
